name: The Secret of Josephine's Soul
source:
Ruth came to work as a maid in a mansion that everyone feared. When Ruth sensed danger from her lady, she realized that she had to run away. But could she escape the feelings between them?

[From [url=https://aihara-0913.itch.io/the-secret-of-josephines-soul]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
露丝来到了所有人都害怕的豪宅里当女仆。当露丝从她的女士那里感觉到危险时，她意识到自己必须逃跑。但她能逃避他们之间的感情吗？

[来自[url=https://aihara-0913.itch.io/the-secret-of-josephines-soul]Itch.io[/url]]
